command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $alias='shopvivaliz-vm'; $remote=@'
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /home/ubuntu/mei-mg-email
if sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause; then echo SENTINEL=present; sudo systemctl stop mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; exit 52; fi
echo SENTINEL=absent
git fetch origin main >/dev/null 2>&1
git checkout origin/main -- app/queue_manager.py worker/safe_entrypoint.py
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile app/queue_manager.py worker/safe_entrypoint.py worker/safe_entrypoint_v2.py
sent_before=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '24 hours';")
pending_before=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('pendente','pending','enviando','processing');")
echo SENT24_BEFORE=$sent_before
echo PENDING_BEFORE=$pending_before
if [ "$sent_before" -lt 9950 ] && [ "$pending_before" -lt 300 ]; then
  set +e
  timeout 100s .venv/bin/python -u - <<'PY'
import psycopg
from app.config import settings
from app.queue_manager import repor_fila_automatica
with psycopg.connect(settings.database_url) as conn:
    print('AUTOQUEUE_ADDED='+str(repor_fila_automatica(conn)), flush=True)
PY
  echo AUTOQUEUE_RC=$?
  set -e
fi
sudo systemctl reset-failed mei-mg-email-worker.service || true
sudo systemctl restart mei-mg-email-worker.service
sudo systemctl enable mei-mg-email-worker.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 70
echo WORKER=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
if sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause; then echo SENTINEL_AFTER=present; else echo SENTINEL_AFTER=absent; fi
echo SENT15=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '15 minutes';")
echo SENT24_AFTER=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '24 hours';")
echo PENDING_AFTER=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('pendente','pending','enviando','processing');")
echo LATEST=$(sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -c "select coalesce(max(enviado_em)::text,'none') from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado');")
asn=$(sudo journalctl -u mei-mg-email-worker.service --since '-15 minutes' --no-pager | grep -Eic 'AS\(42004\)|bad outbound sender|5\.1\.8' || true)
echo AS42004_LAST15M=$asn
if [ "$asn" -gt 0 ]; then sudo touch /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause; sudo systemctl stop mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; echo FAIL_CLOSED=AS42004; exit 53; fi
'@; $out=& $ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 $alias $remote 2>$null; $out | ForEach-Object {Write-Output $_}; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'remote deploy/resume failed'}
reason: Observable production sender recovery after permanent explicit-authorization and queue cursor fixes
